audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart rows contradict this page's own whys: sides read Graves / Skill x5 / Graves while whys[1] through whys[5] all describe Graves winning and whys[6] describes Volibear winning late.
audit.why: Both packets agree here and the mirror was already set to the packet chart, so there is no ambiguity — only the sides were stale.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-6: Skill / Graves / Graves / Graves / Graves / Graves / Volibear, ratings 5/3/3/3/3/3/7 from Volibear's side.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3] tells the player to run Graves down 'every time Quickdraw is on cooldown', and phases[4] calls level 3-6 the strongest window of the lane.
audit.why: Quickdraw is 16/15/14/13/12s and 'Hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill' — a farming Graves is almost never without it. Levels 3-6 belong to him, per both packets.
audit.corrected: Stormbringer is 160s at rank 1 and disables the tower, but Quickdraw plus Smoke Screen peel the leap — dive with a jungler.

audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATED AND MIS-SLOTTED NAMES. The page calls Graves's Q 'Buckshot' (twice) and calls his dash 'End of the Line (E)' (five times). End of the Line is the Q; the dash is Quickdraw (E); there is no ability called Buckshot.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon slots: P New Destiny, Q End of the Line (925 range, 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s), W Smoke Screen, E Quickdraw (425 dash), R Collateral Damage. This is the same class of error as 'Ares of Blaze' for Pyroclasm.
audit.corrected: End of the Line (Q) is the shell that detonates after 1 second or instantly on terrain; Quickdraw (E) is the 425-range dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields say Smoke Screen 'blinds your autos'.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'creates a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly.' It denies vision and slows — it does not blind, so your autos still land on a target you can see.
audit.corrected: Smoke Screen cuts your sight from 950 range; it is 26s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: New Destiny's minion-block property is never mentioned, and it is the single best piece of laning counterplay in this matchup.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units.' Standing with the minion wave between you and Graves eats most of his shot.
audit.corrected: Stand behind your minions — his shells fire four bullets that cannot pass through units.

audit.whatIsWrong: late says your 'R pins him through the dash'.
audit.why: Stormbringer slows and damages; Riot's text gives it no root or pin. The slow is what sticks to him, and Quickdraw can still dash out of it.
audit.corrected: Stormbringer's slow sticks to him through Quickdraw — it does not pin him.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Graves has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q + W online, but Smoke Screen lands from 950 and cuts your sight — he trades from outside the range you can even see.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Graves under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sky Splitter completes the pattern — 1200 range, and it shields you if you stand in the blast. Use it to survive his burst, not to start it.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Graves down every time Quickdraw is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: W ranks make the bite chunk hard, but Quickdraw is 16s and his own attacks cut that cooldown — the dash is rarely actually down.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Graves under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Stormbringer online at 160s and it disables his tower, but Quickdraw plus Smoke Screen still peel the leap. Dive with a jungler, not alone.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Graves to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Sundered Sky crit-heals your first hit, but a full-health Graves out-bursts that heal — take the fight only after his Q is spent.

edits.before: Level 2 Graves gets Smoke Screen (W) to blind your autos and win the trade.
edits.after: Level 2 Smoke Screen (W) cuts your sight from 950 and wins the trade.

edits.before: Level 3-5 Buckshot burst plus True Grit armor out-trade your melee damage.
edits.after: Level 3-5 End of the Line burst plus True Grit armor out-trade you.

edits.before: His End of the Line (E) dash escapes your dive even as you hit power spikes.
edits.after: His Quickdraw (E) dash escapes your dive even as you hit power spikes.

edits.before: Graves shreds you here: his Buckshot (Q) burst, True Grit armor stacking, and Smoke Screen (W) blind neuter your autos, while his End of the Line (E) dash escapes your Q run-down.
edits.after: Graves shreds you here: End of the Line (Q) detonates after 1 second or instantly on terrain, True Grit stacks armor, and Quickdraw (E) escapes your walk-up on a cooldown his autos keep cutting.

edits.before: Even with Stormbringer (R), a good Graves End of the Line (E) dash plus Smoke Screen (W) can slip your leap; his double-shot burst still out-damages your dive if he full-combos.
edits.after: Even with Stormbringer (R), a good Graves slips your leap with Quickdraw (E) and Smoke Screen (W); Collateral Damage (R) is a 1000-range nuke on 100s, so his full combo out-damages your dive.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 belong to Graves. Smoke Screen (W) blinds your autos, Buckshot (Q) and True Grit let him win short trades, and End of the Line (E) escapes your dive. Farm safely, don't force all-ins into his cooldowns, and give up a little CS rather than dying.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 belong to Graves. Smoke Screen (W) cuts your sight, End of the Line (Q) and True Grit win short trades, and Quickdraw (E) escapes your dive. Stand behind your minions — his shells fire four bullets that cannot pass through units. Give up CS rather than dying.

edits.before: With tanky items your profile flips. Your W heal outlasts his shot cooldowns and R pins him through the dash, so any extended brawl after his Q is spent goes to you. Punish him the moment his burst is on cooldown.
edits.after: With tanky items your profile flips. Frenzied Maul heals every 5 seconds and Stormbringer's slow sticks to him through Quickdraw, so any extended brawl after End of the Line is spent goes to you.

edits.before: Bait his Buckshot (Q) and Smoke Screen (W) before you commit
edits.after: Bait End of the Line (Q) and Smoke Screen (W) before committing

edits.before: All-in only after his End of the Line (E) dash is down
edits.after: All-in only after his Quickdraw (E) dash is spent

edits.before: Blind your autos with Smoke Screen (W) whenever you step up
edits.after: Cut your sight with Smoke Screen (W) whenever you step up

edits.before: Kite your Q run-down with End of the Line (E) dash
edits.after: Kite your Q run-down with the Quickdraw (E) dash

edits.before: Burst you with Buckshot (Q) plus passive double-shot before you heal
edits.after: Burst you with End of the Line (Q) plus his double shot before you heal

edits.before: - Graves Quickdraw: matchup-defining — His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Quickdraw: matchup-defining — 425 dash on 16s stacking armor, and his attacks lower it. - End of the Line: 13s at rank 1.

edits.before: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A 425 dash on 16s that stacks armor — and his autos cut its cooldown further.

edits.before: Track Graves's Quickdraw: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Q-stun + W reset bite.
edits.after: Quickdraw is a 425 dash on 16s that his autos shorten. His shells fire four bullets that minions block.

notes: This page carried a fabricated ability name ('Buckshot') and a mis-slotted one ('End of the Line (E)') across seven fields, plus a 'blind' that Smoke Screen does not have. All three are corrected here. Not asserted: whether Smoke Screen's sight reduction stops auto-attack targeting at all — Riot's text only says sight range, so the rewrite claims vision denial and nothing more.
